IC1: History of other significant skin disease [OR], or skin manifestations [AND] of allergic illness [OR] or other dermatologic condition, [NOT] except chronic moderate [OR] or severe atopic dermatitis, that would interfere with the trial assessments or compromise the patient's safety according to the opinion of the Investigator
IC2: Present symptoms of other skin diseases, [NOT] except chronic atopic dermatitis, that could disturb the study assessment and evaluation of the skin
IC3: Current use of any active systemic medication [AND] for chronic atopic dermatitis within one month
IC4: Current use of active topical medication [AND] in the planned investigational area for chronic atopic dermatitis within two weeks
IC5: History of a sunny holiday [OR], UV-light therapy [OR] or solarium use within one month before beginning of study treatments, or planning such during the study [OR] or within 7 days after the study
IC6: Allergy to cis-UCA [OR], or any constituents of the placebo emulsion cream [OR] or any constituents of Protopic® ointment
IC8: Congenital or acquired immunodeficiency [OR] or ongoing therapy that cause immunosuppression [AND]
IC9: Earlier participation in a clinical study performed with cis-UCA
IC10: Any clinically significant laboratory test result
IC11: Suspected current drug [OR] or alcohol abuse
IC12: Clinically significant illness during the 4 weeks prior to the first dose administration
IC13: Any other condition that in the opinion of the Investigator would interfere with the evaluation of the study results or constitute a health hazard for the patient
IC14: Unwillingness or doubtful capacity to comply with the protocol
IC15: Doubtful availability to complete the study
